editorialDecl.p: The Latin text, page breaks, speech divisions, verse groups, notes, and surviving Greek-line ranges follow the source transcription. Running heads and isolated folio furniture are excluded. Source corrections are regularized as choice/sic/corr. Canonical card milestones carry resp="Smyth". Explicit gaps preserve absent passages without assigning their cards to unrelated Latin text.
